# Training test fixtures (FLAGGED FOR HUMAN REVIEW)

Offline, test-only fixtures that exercise the ER training pipeline deterministically.
They do **not** weaken any production gate.

## `quality_gates_relaxed.yaml`
Relaxed thresholds **for tests only**, so the tiny offline dataset can reach the
gate-PASS → train path. The real `registry/data/quality_gates.yaml` and the
committed `pipelines/endpoints/ER/config.yaml` stay strict and unapproved; the
strict **gate-blocks-training** path is tested separately with the real thresholds.

## `er_pipeline.test.yaml`
A test-only `PipelineConfig`: relaxed gate + `approved: true`, **staged** adapter
pointing at `staged/er/` below, nested evaluation over the five sklearn models.
The committed pipeline config is unaffected.

## `staged/er/` (staged-format nested-CV fixture)
A **staged-format** dataset (Parquet signatures + CSV label/mapping) read by the
`StagedSourceAdapter`, large enough for **nested grouped CV** (16 compounds: 8
active, 8 inactive → ≥5 compound groups for the configured outer×inner folds).
Generated by `staged/er/make_staged_er_fixture.py`:
- `lincs.parquet` — 16 signatures × 5 landmark genes; gene values carry **no class
  signal** (each pattern appears equally in both classes), so the honest nested
  AUROC sits near 0.5 and the end-to-end run deterministically registers ER as
  **`experimental`** — proving the threshold/status path without fabricating
  metrics.
- `toxcast.csv` — 16 binary labels; `tox21.csv` / `cerapp.csv` are header-only
  (present so the selected ER label sources resolve); `pubchem.csv` — CASRN and
  PERT_ID → InChIKey mapping.

> Reviewer note: a deliberate, documented stand-in. A reviewed ER run uses real
> staged data and produces real metrics. The schemas mimic the assumed real source
> shapes and must be confirmed before real-data execution.

## `datasets/` (legacy small fixture)
The 2-group weak-signal CSV set is retained for reference. The end-to-end
pipeline tests now use `staged/er/` (nested CV needs more groups); `datasets/` is no
longer referenced by the pipeline tests. The dataset layer fixtures under
`tests/fixtures/datasets/` are left untouched.
